body: Raw appetite and ownership: you refuse to be denied pleasure, money, or your own body. A deep, sensing bond with the physical and natural world; the instinct is rooted in the body and in what is genuinely yours. Misdirected it grasps at money or leans on others' resources; owned, it becomes a grounded, restorative presence. Time in nature and reconnecting with the body are the way back.
business: Owned, this is unapologetic enjoyment and a clear sense of what is yours.
shadow: Suppressed it becomes shame around desire; unchecked, possessiveness and excess.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
